Location: inside <color_c_green>++</color> jeans > 5 <color_c_light_gray><color_c_green>++</color> ballistic glasses</color> / 8 items
Origin: 'Dark Days Ahead'
--
Material: <color_c_light_blue>Plastic</color>, <color_c_light_blue>Aluminum</color>
Volume: <color_c_yellow>0.01</color> L  Weight: <color_c_yellow>0.07</color> kg
Length: <color_c_yellow>2</color> cm
Owner: Your Followers
Category: <color_c_magenta>Tools</color>
--
A disposable plastic lighter, capable of creating a small flame with the flick of a finger.  Allows you to use various drugs like cigarettes, light explosives like Molotov cocktails, or light nearby items on fire.
--
Stands a <color_c_red>very low</color> chance of remaining intact once fired.
--
<color_c_white>Charges</color>: 100
Maximum <color_c_yellow>100</color> charges of butane.
--
<color_c_white>Actions</color>: <color_c_cyan>Start a fire quickly</color>
--
<color_c_white>Repair</color> using integrated soldering iron, integrated welder, gunsmith repair kit, firearm repair kit, soldering iron, portable soldering iron, arc welder, makeshift arc welder, or high-temperature welding kit.
<color_c_white>With</color> <color_c_cyan>plastic chunk</color> and <color_c_cyan>aluminum welding wire</color>.
--
<color_c_white>Disassembly</color> takes about 30 seconds and might yield: 1 pilot light.
--
* This item <color_c_red>conducts</color> electricity.
* This item can start <color_red>fire</color>.
--
<color_c_white>Contents of this item</color>:
<color_c_light_red>butane (100)</color>
A common flammable liquid, used in lighters.  <color_c_yellow>0.10</color> L
--
<color_c_white>Can be stored in (worn)</color>: <color_c_green>jeans</color>.  And 349 unworn wearables.
--
Price: $<color_c_yellow>0.10</color>  Barter value: $<color_c_yellow>0.10</color>
--
You know of nothing you could craft with it.
--
